narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack tangled · EMA spread -7.58 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 2.223-2.263 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip), where the footprint printed its confirmation. Risk is defined beyond 2.300; the first objective pays 1.70R at 2.201.
